name: eda-marketing
description: Claude Code plugin + workspace for short-form video marketing: research → ideas → hooks → script → shot list → Remotion montage → HyperFrames motion → captions → publish copy → QA → analytics.

scripts.studio: tsx engine/src/cli.ts video register && npm --workspace @mos/remotion run studio --
scripts.test:remotion: tsx engine/src/cli.ts video register && tsx scripts/test-remotion.ts
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p engine && npm --workspace @mos/remotion run lint
scripts.check: tsx engine/src/cli.ts video register && npm run lint && npm test && tsx engine/src/cli.ts validate --all
